lastCompletedStory.title: Thread backend into the readPhaseModel drift-guard test

nextStoryContext: readPhaseModel vs repo project.toml (drift guard) in test/config/models.test.ts now resolves readPhaseBackend(phase, repoConfigPath) first, passes it as the 3rd positional arg to readPhaseModel, and derives `expected` with the same resolution order (nested [models.<backend>].<phase> when backend !== 'claude', then flat [models].<phase>, then DEFAULTS[phase]). No src/ file touched; readPhaseModel's optional backend param already existed. The committed scripts/cam/project.toml is all-claude, so this is a no-op today and the suite stays green; the guard is now correct against a future [models.<backend>]-only codex phase.
